title: Deploy
subtitle: Run the project's deploy scripts in an agent terminal
noDescription: No description. Add a comment block at the top of the script to describe it.
terminalLimit: Terminal limit reached. Close a terminal and try again.

empty.title: No deploy scripts found
empty.description: Malvy looks for deploy*.sh files in the project root and up to two folders down, like deploy.sh or deploy-ios.sh.
empty.hint: Comment lines at the top of the script become its description here. A "# Usage: …" line shows which arguments it takes.

task.title: Deploy
task.buttonTooltip: Deploy this merged task with the project's deploy script
task.mergeFirst: Merge the task first, then deploy it from the Done column

warnings.notOnMain: The project is on {{current}}, not {{main}}. The script runs from the current checkout.

task.mergeAndDeployTooltip: Merge this task into the main branch, then run the project's deploy script
task.makeDefault: Use for this project's Deploy button (no question next time)
task.cleanCheckout: The project has uncommitted changes. They stay out of this deploy: the script runs in a clean copy of the merged code, and file changes it makes (like a version bump) are copied back.

defaultTooltip: The Deploy button on task cards runs this script

batch.tooltip: Merges every task here, oldest first (AI resolves conflicts), runs the project's verify command and lets AI fix collisions, then deploys once with the project's deploy script.
batch.stopped: {{merged}} of {{total}} tasks were merged before it stopped; nothing was deployed.
batch.verifyFailed: Verify still fails after merging; nothing was deployed
batch.verifyFailedUncommitted: Verify fails and the project has uncommitted changes, so AI didn't try to fix it; nothing was deployed
batch.fixed: AI fixed a collision between the merged tasks and committed the fix
